title: Fix selection transform pipeline: center-based scale/rotate, transformed bounds
description: Transform math contradicts the renderer, so rotate/resize makes shapes orbit/leap away (StageArea.tsx:1046-1095): stage-drawn shapes have absolute path coords with obj.x=obj.y=0, and the renderer applies translate/rotate/scale about the stage ORIGIN (renderer.ts:410-424), but the rotate handle computes angles about the bounds center and resize assumes in-place scaling. Also shapeBounds ignores scaleX/scaleY/rotation entirely (engine/shapes.ts), so selection box, handles, and hit-testing desync from the rendered shape after any transform. Define transform-about-center semantics (or bake a registration point), make bounds/hit-testing transform-aware, and ensure publish carries the resulting matrix (0042 added MATRIX support). Distort/Envelope modes remain 0030 scope. See docs/04-toolbox.md Free Transform.
